policies.name: assessment questions follow assessment
policies.check:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM assessments a
  WHERE ((a.id = assessment_questions.assessment_id) AND ((a.owner_user_id = auth.uid()) OR has_question_bank_role(ARRAY['admin'::text, 'administrador_nacional'::text, 'gestor'::text, 'gestor_da_rede'::text, 'service_role'::text]))))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM question_items qi
  WHERE ((qi.id = assessment_questions.question_id) AND (qi.publication_status = 'PUBLICADO'::question_publication_status) AND (qi.curation_status = ANY (ARRAY['APROVADO'::question_curation_status, 'PUBLICADO'::question_curation_status, 'HOMOLOGADO'::question_curation_status])) AND (qi.legal_classification <> 'ITEM_BLOQUEADO_PUBLICACAO'::question_legal_classification)))))
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM assessments a
  WHERE ((a.id = assessment_questions.assessment_id) AND ((a.owner_user_id = auth.uid()) OR has_question_bank_role(ARRAY['admin'::text, 'administrador_nacional'::text, 'gestor'::text, 'gestor_da_rede'::text, 'service_role'::text])))))

policies.name: assessment_questions_student_assigned_select
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM assessment_assignments aa
  WHERE ((aa.assessment_id = assessment_questions.assessment_id) AND avalia_student_can_access_assignment(aa.id, avalia_current_student_id()))))
